'''2009 Yavin 4 Regionals Sean Ryan LS Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Sean Ryan]] at [[2009 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber|JP-L-jabbaspalaceaudiencechamber.gif}}
